title: NICE Link Suppression: Digital Policing Evidence Trail vs Public Denials
description: This timeline visualizes the sequence of NICE evidence links sent via Digital Policing from November 4 to November 14, 2024, alongside later denials by Veritas (Emma Jones) and Sussex Police that such evidence was ever provided or received.

events.summary: Digital Policing sends Ben a NICE link to submit evidence via secure portal.
Second NICE link issued to Ben referencing Jonathan Dixon.
Further email references prior links and timelines for expiry.
Final email in the sequence with no confirmation of review by Sussex Police.
Emma Jones (Veritas) claims NICE links were not used or relevant.
Final NICE link communication sent to Ben on Dec 13, no follow-up recorded.
